answer.summary: Verify the presence of explicitly reported, mathematically defined memory decay models in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 under controlled perturbations.
answer.content: This investigation confirms whether Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 contains a clear, verifiable decay model (e.g., exponential, polynomial, piecewise) that quantitatively describes how memory state evolves over time under known perturbations, with defined parameters and temporal bounds. Only directly stated models count; no inference or external assumption is permitted. The finding must be extractable and unambiguous from the source text alone.
